request.questionText: The Auror Recruitment Office looks for student candidates who score in the top 7% on the NEWT-level Potions exam. Scores for this exam follow a normal distribution with a mean of 500 points and a standard deviation of 100 points. Which of the following is closest to the cutoff score for a compelling application to the Auror training program? HINT: use the qnorm() function as seen in class
